# WP Blog Agent

This directory is intended to hold the complete files generated from model conversations and iMessage message exports.

## Purpose

- Archive complete model outputs
- Preserve exported iMessage conversations and related files
- Keep all generated artifacts together in one place for review and reference

## Included

- Full model-generated files 
- Message exports from iMessage
- Supporting project artifacts

## Notes

This is a local archive for complete records and reference material only. It is not intended to be a production runtime or deployment package.
